patches.reason: Fail closed on malformed purchase/redemption inputs; require temporary-shop purchases to originate within 32 studs of the exact serialized DIALOG_* anchor for that shop; execute permanent/loyalty mutations synchronously; and serialize permanent/loyalty purchase helpers per player across every caller.

replacements.new:
local temporaryShopDialogAnchors = {
	["Chef Umbra's"] = {"DIALOG_Umbra"},
	["Club Red"] = {"DIALOG_Dexter"},
	["School Cafeteria"] = {"DIALOG_Rude Lunch Lady","DIALOG_Chill Lunch Lady","DIALOG_Noob Lunch Lady"},
	["Snack Shack"] = {"DIALOG_Wendy"},
	["Sunblox Cafe"] = {"DIALOG_Alyssa"},
}

local function canAccessTemporaryShop(plr,shopname)
	local anchorNames = temporaryShopDialogAnchors[shopname]
	local character = plr and plr.Character
	local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
	if not anchorNames or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	for _,anchorName in pairs(anchorNames) do
		local anchor = workspace:FindFirstChild(anchorName)
		if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") and (root.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude <= 32 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function PurchasePermanentItem(plr,itemid)
	if permanentPurchaseBusy[plr] then
		return false,"Please wait for your current purchase to finish."
	end
	permanentPurchaseBusy[plr] = true
	local ok,result,reason = pcall(PurchasePermanentItemUnlocked,plr,itemid)
	permanentPurchaseBusy[plr] = nil
	if not ok then

	return result,reason
end
